# SuperDoc Document Outline

A runnable React example using public SuperDoc APIs for native heading discovery, live updates, and expandable navigation.

- [Build guide](./guide.md): APIs, source files, installation, optional inference, privacy and verification.
- [Source](https://github.com/superdoc/demos/tree/main/document-outline)
- [Document API info](https://docs.superdoc.dev/document-api/reference/info/)
